title: Make mobile navigation usable
brief: Improve the independent demo frontend navigation on narrow screens. Preserve its palette and existing content. Implement in the recorded task worktree.
criteria: At 375px width the navigation fits without horizontal page scrolling.
A labeled menu button opens and closes the mobile links and reports its expanded state.
Menu links can be reached with the keyboard; Escape closes the menu and restores focus to the toggle.
At desktop width the existing horizontal links remain visible.
sourceReference: Replace with the optional Discord message link
